arxiv-2106-00423.title: Reentrant Transitions in a Mixture of Small and Big Particles Interacting via Soft Repulsive Potential
arxiv-2106-00423.creator: Itay Azizi 1, Alexander Y. Grosberg 2, Yitzhak Rabin 1
arxiv-2106-00423.description: Abstract We report the first observation of temperature-controlled reentrant transition in simulations of mixtures of small and big particles interacting via soft repulsive potential in 2D. As temperature increases, the system passes from a fluid mixture, to a crystal of big particles in a fluid of small particles and back to a fluid mixture.

arxiv-2208-02316.title: Normalized Solutions to the mixed fractional Schrödinger equations with potential and general nonlinear term
arxiv-2208-02316.creator: Anouar Bahrouni Qi Guo Hichem Hajaiej
arxiv-2208-02316.description: Abstract Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to establish the existence of solutions with prescribed norm to a class of nonlinear equations involving the mixed fractional Laplacians. This type of equations arises in various fields ranging from biophysics to population dynamics. Due to the importance of these applications, this topic has very recently received an increasing interest.

arxiv-2212-06119.title: Cosmic voids are emptier in the presence of symmetron’s domain walls
arxiv-2212-06119.creator: Bahar Nosrati, Nima Khosravi
arxiv-2212-06119.description: Abstract The symmetron field has an environment (density) dependent behavior which is a common feature of the models with the screening mechanism and results in a rich phenomenology. This model can produce domain walls between regions with different densities. We consider this aspect and study the physics of domain walls in between (underdensity) voids and (overdensity) halo structures.

arxiv-2403-04214.title: Exponential decay property for eigenfunctions of quantum walks
arxiv-2403-04214.creator: Kazuyuki Wada
arxiv-2403-04214.description: Abstract . Under an abstract setting, we show that eigenvectors belong to discrete spectra of unitary operators have exponential decay properties. We apply the main theorem to multi-dimensional quantum walks and show that eigenfunctions belong to a discrete spectrum decay exponentially at infinity. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 81Q35; Secondary 47B02, 47B15, 47B93 1.

arxiv-2510-12245.title: MoRA: On-the-fly Molecule-aware Low-Rank Adaptation Framework for LLM-based Multi-Modal Molecular Assistant
arxiv-2510-12245.creator: Tao Yin, Xiaohong Zhang, Jiacheng Zhang, Li Huang, Zhibin Zhang, Yuansong Zeng, Jin Xie, Meng Yan
arxiv-2510-12245.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tao Yin, Xiaohong Zhang, Jiacheng Zhang, Li Huang, Zhibin Zhang, Yuansong Zeng, Jin Xie, Meng Yan. Effectively integrating molecular graph structures with Large Language Models (LLMs) is a key challenge in drug discovery. Most existing multi-modal alignment methods typically process these structures by fine-tuning the LLM or adding a static adapter simultaneously.

pmc-11545331.title: Bioactive Peptides from Fermented Foods: Production Approaches, Sources, and Potential Health Benefits
pmc-11545331.creator: Laryssa Peres Fabbri, Andrea Cavallero, Francesca Vidotto, Morena Gabriele, Wenjing Cui
pmc-11545331.description: Microbial fermentation is a well-known strategy for enhancing the nutraceutical attributes of foods. Among the fermentation outcomes, bioactive peptides (BAPs), short chains of amino acids resulting from proteolytic activity, are emerging as promising components thanks to their bioactivities. Indeed, BAPs offer numerous health benefits, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, antihypertensive, and anti-inflammatory properties.

pmc-11634868.title: Dynamics of antibody engagement of red blood cells in vivo and in vitro
pmc-11634868.creator: Ryan P. Jajosky, Diyoly Ayona, Amanda Mener, Sean R. Stowell, Connie M. Arthur
pmc-11634868.description: Exposure to allogenic red blood cells (RBCs), either through pregnancy or transfusion, can result in alloimmunization, which can lead to severe hemolytic transfusion reactions and pregnancy complications. Passively administered antibodies can be used to prevent alloimmunization, where steric hindrance of allogeneic epitopes has been postulated as one mechanism whereby antibody engagement may prevent RBC alloimmunization.

pmc-11845369.title: Robot-assisted computed tomography-guided percutaneous biopsy and cryoablation for subcentimeter pulmonary metastatic sarcoma: China's first reported case

pmc-11845369.description: . Clinical Summary A 27-year-old man underwent left shoulder lipoma resection at the Affiliated Hospital of Jinan University during February 2023. Postoperative pathology revealed an abnormal sarcoma, later confirmed as a mesenchymal malignant tumor through immunohistochemistry and a pathology consultation at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center.

pmc-13490552.title: Spin-coordinated mixed-valence transport via indium-induced perovskite-spinel heterointerface in oxygen electrode for reversible protonic ceramic cells
pmc-13490552.creator: Yinlin Chang, Tao Liu, Jingyuan Rao, Shuanglin Zheng, Min Fu, Hanping Ding, Zetian Tao
pmc-13490552.description: Achieving efficient oxygen electrocatalysis in protonic ceramic electrochemical cells requires more than accelerating surface reactions, which demands precise coordination of electronic and spin states across the bulk-interface continuum. Conventional strategies based on vacancy engineering or catalyst infiltration increase active sites, yet they do not intrinsically couple bulk charge transport with interfacial redox kinetics.
